subject: Publisher bootstrap: CloudOps offer + account provisioning
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudops.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Publisher bootstrap: CloudOps offer + account provisioning

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for taking this on. We're ready to start onboarding our service to the Azure Marketplace and need help with publisher account provisioning and the technical validation gate. High-level asks:

- Publisher account activation (we have a tenant but no publisher binding yet)
- Shared manifest check (we'll send a draft payload)
- SPN/service-principal + privatelink checks for our SaaS connector
- Co-sell readiness checklist and evidence we should prepare (SOC / SCS items)

I'm attaching our initial manifest draft and a scanned copy of the publisher ID paperwork. Can the team confirm the earliest slot for a validation run? Our timeline is tight — aiming for co-sell enablement by mid-December.

Attachments: azure-offer-manifest.json (draft), publisher-id-proofs.zip

Cheers,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships, CloudOps Ltd
samir@cloudops.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Publisher bootstrap: CloudOps offer + account provisioning

Team — looping you in to coordinate CloudOps' publisher bootstrap. Quick plan:

1) Marissa: take point on manifest review and co-sell mapping (pricing SKUs, offer type). Confirm manifest schema and flag incompatible fields.
2) Karthik: validate SPN provisioning/privatelink approach and confirm network egress expectations for validation.
3) Irene: collect SOC/SCS evidence and handle the portal proof items (identities, logos, screenshots).

Target: technical validation run scheduled week of Nov 8 (we can push to Nov 9). Marissa, can you prepare a sanitized manifest and list of required changes by EOD Nov 6? Karthik, can you confirm whether CloudOps' architecture needs a staging SPN or if we can reuse their tenant-level SPN? Irene, please review the attached ID proofs and start the evidence request to CloudOps.

I'll own the hub/handoff to Azure if we need to open a support case.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudops.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Publisher bootstrap: CloudOps offer + account provisioning

Hi Samir — thanks for the manifest and the ID bundle. We're good to run an initial lint and mapping pass. Quick notes after a first look:

- Attached: azure-offer-manifest.json (sanitized, comments inline) — see sections marked "FIXME" for SKU/pricing items that won't pass co-sell mapping.
- Offer type should be "SaaS" with a private plan for initial testing; public listing can be gated until validation is complete.
- We need a test tenant ID and an offer payload that completes the provisioning flow (sample POST/response). Can you provide a sandbox tenant and the API endpoint for our smoke tests?

Next steps: please share the sandbox tenant + API creds (SPN or temporary key). We'll run the manifest lint and produce a short remediation list by EOD Nov 6.

Attachments: azure-offer-manifest.json

Marissa Cole
Sr. Marketplace Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Azure Marketplace Support <mp-support@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Publisher bootstrap: CloudOps offer + account provisioning

Marissa — attaching the sandbox details and the evidence pack you asked for.

Sandbox tenant: tenant-id 72f3b9c1-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-3b2e7e1a5d9c
API endpoint (staging): https://staging-api.cloudops.com/provision
SPN for staging (limited): appId=abc-xxx secret=xxxx (we'll send secure creds via the portal)

Attachments: scs-evidence.pdf (SOC docs excerpt)

I've also opened a support ticket with Azure Marketplace (case #MP-20261109-462). They said they'd prioritize the validation if we can confirm publisher binding and manifest sanity.

One more question — for co-sell enablement, do you need a DocuSign'ed MSA before the offer can be published as co-sell? Happy to route that now if it speeds things up.

Thanks,
Samir

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudops.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Publisher bootstrap: CloudOps offer + account provisioning

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Samir. Summary and next steps: 

- Validation run scheduled: Nov 9 (completed smoke), full technical validation slot Nov 11 at 10:00 PT.
- Marissa: manifest lint done; see Drive runbook for remediation checklist.
- Karthik: please confirm SPN entitlement mapping today — we need service principal permissions for the staging subscription (Contributor + User Access Administrator scoped to the resource group).
- Irene: evidence receipt acknowledged; please upload SCS/SOC snippets to the portal and confirm redaction completeness.
- Samir: please complete DocuSign for the MSA (link below) if you want co-sell to be queued immediately after validation. It is not strictly required to run technical validation but it shortens the co-sell enablement path.

Links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765
Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-offer-runbook
DocuSign (MSA): https://www.docusign.com/containers/abc123-offer-agreement

I'll open the marketplace support escalation once Karthik confirms the SPN mapping. Goal: go-live window mid-December as requested.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
